en: Amanojaku appeared!{KP}"Hey! Hey! Momotaro! I'll grant you a wish!"{KP}"Go on, pick whichever one you like!"

jp:
「フッ…
　しぶいぜ　桃太郎！」

「ヘイ！　ヘイ！　今でも
　十分　みがるだぞ！」{KP}
「他の　のぞみを
　選びなおしな　桃太郎！」
en: "Hey! Hey! You're already traveling plenty light!"{KP}"Pick another wish, Momotaro!"
Momotaro had {MM} stolen from his item bag!{KP}He seems to feel just a little lighter...{KP}"Heh... Lookin' sharp, Momotaro!"

jp:
「ヘイ！　ヘイ！　桃太郎！
　ホントに　それで　いいのか？」{KP}
「よーく　かんがえて
　選びなおすんだ！」
en: "Hey! Hey! Momotaro! You really sure about that?"{KP}"Think it over real good and pick again!"

jp:
「あつい？　そんなに　あついなら
　ふところを　さむくしてやろう！」
en: "Hot? If you're that hot, I'll make your wallet nice and chilly!"

jp:
桃太郎は　お金を
{R2}両　とられてしまった！{KP}
「フッ…
　クールに　きめたな　桃太郎！」
en: Momotaro had {R2} ryo taken from him!{KP}"Heh... Now that was cool, Momotaro!"
